sanskrit_verse: पलायनादनुत्तरादन्यपक्षाश्रयेण च । हीनस्य गृह्यते वादो न स्ववाक्यजितस्य च ॥
transliteration: palāyanād anuttarād anyapakṣāśrayeṇa ca / hīnasya gṛhyate vādo na svavākyajitasya ca //
sph_interpretive_translation: When one flees from direct response, resorts to another's position, or is diminished in capacity, their argument is not accepted; likewise, one who has already won through their own word does not engage further.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in self-established truth, not borrowed stance
Causation follows integrity of response, not evasion
Capacity-based responsibility requires presence and clarity of voice
Restoration logic demands confrontation and completion over avoidance
Consciousness alignment occurs when one stands by their own declared truth
executable_legal_axioms: IF a litigant avoids direct reply OR relies on external authority without internalization THEN disqualify their claim from standing
IF a respondent has already established their case through clear self-expression THEN no further obligation to respond exists
IF a party demonstrates diminished capacity through flight or deflection THEN invalidate continuation of that line of argument
ENSURE all disputants maintain ontological presence in discourse UNTIL resolution is achieved
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this axiom establishes that appeals or arguments based on evasion, deflection, or lack of personal mastery over the subject are inherently invalid. The court must recognize self-authority as the threshold for legitimate participation in dharma-adjudication.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality locates validity in direct cognition and self-owned speech. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that flight or reliance on another’s view indicates unresolved internal disorder. Responsibility aligns with capacity to remain present. There is no punishment—only non-recognition of misaligned engagement until restoration of self-standing occurs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process requiring return to point of evasion
Assign reflective silence period to restore inner alignment
Reintegrate capacity through guided self-repetition of original stance
Verify readiness through spontaneous reaffirmation of position
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Truth unowned becomes unaccepted. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Reality remains non-punitive.
